scope: User-selected integration target for candidate or team development branches; fixed comparison baseline separate from implementation starting commit.
decisions: Explicit first-start target, then plan setting, team setting, repository default; explicit target must agree with declared plan target.
Ready plan and approved specs reside on chosen target, not necessarily main; actual starting tree must contain the reviewed revisions.
Keep plan/<id> implementation branches; candidate receives their work and is separately reviewed for promotion.
Record target and actual starting commit at first start; optional comparison commit stays fixed.
Use recorded target for lifecycle, dependency state, PR base, merge and cleanup; no implicit retargeting.
Distinct candidate plan IDs; require unfinished stacked dependencies to share a target.
Automated candidate generation/ranking/promotion, arbitrary existing-branch adoption and started-plan retargeting are outside this proposal.
